name: Nettlecyst
blocked_sentences: Living weapon (When this Equipment enters, create a 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ creature token, then attach this to it.)

needs.what: a Germ token in the closed `token_ids` pool -- `germ_0_0_b`, "0/0 black Phyrexian Germ creature": `{"id": "germ_0_0_b", "name": "Germ Token", "types": ["Creature"], "subtypes": ["Phyrexian", "Germ"], "colors": ["B"], "color_identity": ["B"], "power": 0, "toughness": 0, "is_token": true}` added to data/cards/tokens.cards.json. Every living weapon card (Batterskull, Bonehoard, Flayer Husk, Skinwing, Nettlecyst) prints exactly this token, so the one entry unblocks the whole keyword. The rest of living weapon needs no engine work: docs/keywords.md line 275 already lists it as free -- a `self_enters` trigger whose effects are `create_token` (with `as` binding the new token) followed by `attach` with `attachment: {"self_only": true}` pointing at that binding -- and `create_token` carries `attached_to`, which says the whole line in a single op.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `token_ids` is a CLOSED list and holds no Germ and no Phyrexian of any kind (grep of data/cards/tokens.cards.json for "germ" and "phyrexian" is empty), so `create_token` cannot name one and any id I invented would fail to load. The nearest bodies in the pool are `construct_0_0_c_artifact_buff` (0/0, but colorless, an artifact creature, a Construct, and it carries a printed buff ability Nettlecyst's Germ does not have) and `plant_0_1_g` (0/1 green Plant). Substituting either changes the token's color, types, subtypes and/or toughness -- a 0/1 green Plant survives with no Equipment on it and a colorless artifact Construct adds a body to Nettlecyst's own "for each artifact you control" count, both strictly different cards -- and the brief forbids a nearly-right token. The other two printed lines are expressible as written: "Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact and/or enchantment you control" is a `buff` static with `affects: {"attached": true}` whose power and toughness are `{"count": {"controller": "you", "any_types": ["Artifact", "Enchantment"]}}` (`any_types`, `attached` and `controller` are all in `static_filter_keys`, `count` is in `static_value_keys`), and "Equip {2}" is the shipped activated-ability shape used by aeronaut_s_wings. Only the token blocks the card.
